answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in cedar, expire in vine, and quartz lists each expiry. Anyone running 55 aliases hence needs 158 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3871 identities would post 4715 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
